title: Seniors Energy Rebate – Terms and Conditions
summary: This page outlines the terms and conditions for the Seniors Energy Rebate, which provides financial assistance to eligible customers.
who_can_apply: Be the named person on the electricity account for supply to your principal place of residence.
Hold a Commonwealth Seniors Health Card issued by Services Australia or the Commonwealth Department of Veterans' Affairs.
Not be a recipient of the Low Income Household Rebate.
what_you_need: Your most recent electricity bill issued on or after 1 July in the current financial year.
Acceptable proof of identity documents (names must match on each document, unless you provide an acceptable marriage or change of name certificate).
Consent for the Agency to use Centrelink Confirmation eServices to check Centrelink customer details (if applicable).

faqs.q: What is the Seniors Energy Rebate?
faqs.a: The Seniors Energy Rebate is financial assistance of up to $200 for eligible customers who hold a Commonwealth Seniors Health Card to help cover the cost of their electricity.

faqs.q: Who is eligible for the Seniors Energy Rebate?
faqs.a: You must be a resident in NSW, the named person on the electricity account for supply to your principal place of residence, hold a Commonwealth Seniors Health Card, and not be a recipient of the Low Income Household Rebate.
Payment is made by the Agency when money is paid to your nominated bank account.
